cells.gaps: Sources disagree on whether the national data centre operates: the ministry page (COG-006) says it hosts public institutions' data, and the newest source, of September 2026 (COG-010), says it is due by the end of 2026. No rule in force is on file.
cells.note: The national data centre is meant to keep state data in Congo (COG-007, COG-010), so stage 2. The newest source says it will be delivered by the end of 2026, so hosting is not established and the cell is lowered from 4.
